articles.title: Lanterns Finale Confirms A Major Manhunter Theory — But There's A Twist
articles.summary: The 'Lanterns' finale features a flashback revealing Hal Jordan's home ablaze in Rushville, Nebraska. He was saved by Noah Macon, who subsequently utilized advanced Manhunter technology. This pivotal plot development details a critical narrative event within the comic series, focusing on key character dynamics and the deployment of fictional technological elements to advance the storyline.
